scouting.beyondsolo.scout.hello.azure_ti: %1$s. I'm %2$s, of the Azure Tide Guild. The strongest guild in the country wants you. Hear me out.
scouting.beyondsolo.scout.renewal.red_la: %1$s! Your contract's up, and we want you back. Name your price... within reason.
scouting.beyondsolo.scout.renewal.iron_b: %1$s, your contract with us has run its course. We'd like you to stay. Shall we talk terms?
scouting.beyondsolo.scout.renewal.sunfal: %1$s, it's been a good few days. Sunfall would like to keep you. Here's what we can offer.
scouting.beyondsolo.scout.renewal.azure_: %1$s. The guild was pleased with you. It wants to renew, and it pays for what it wants.

ui.beyondsolo.scouting.title: Guild scout
ui.beyondsolo.scouting.great_guild: One of the country's great guilds
ui.beyondsolo.scouting.motto.red_lantern: "Gold first." The biggest signing bonuses of any guild, and the biggest cut of your gate gold. Comes for hunters from rank C.
ui.beyondsolo.scouting.motto.iron_bastio: "We look after our own." A modest bonus and a small cut; its hunters hire hands at the Association for less. Comes from rank B.
ui.beyondsolo.scouting.motto.sunfall: "Earn the country's trust." Its hunters earn more Association merit. Comes from rank A.
ui.beyondsolo.scouting.motto.azure_tide: "Only the strongest." The smallest cut of any guild, and more System XP for its hunters. Comes for S-rank hunters only.

command.beyondsolo.solo.help.scout.offer: Puts that great guild's offer (or every guild's that wants the player's rank) on the table now.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.scout.send: A scout walks up to the player with the best offer on the table.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.scout.talk: The player speaks to the nearest of their scouts, as right-clicking them does: the offer's window.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.no_scout: No scout of %s's is near them.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.scout.lapse: Every offer on the table runs out now.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.scout.list: The offers on the table and on their way: the bonus, the most a guild will pay, the raises, the clock.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.scout.reset: Forgets every offer, the contract and the player's dealings with the guilds; their scouts go home.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.contract.si: Signs the player with the guild now, for its usual bonus.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.contract.ex: The contract runs its course now (the guild asks to renew).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.contract.en: Ends the contract now; nothing is owed.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.contract.in: The contract (the cut, what it has taken, days left, what walking out costs) and the player's dealings with the guilds.
